technique_name: Describe the main character in this book.
description: The protagonist of 'To Kill a Mockingbird' is Atticus Finch, a lawyer in the small town of Maycomb, Alabama. Atticus is a wise and noble man, and he is held in high esteem in his community. He is an advocate for justice and morality, and a defender of the accused. He is also a loving father who is firm but fair with his two children, Jem and Scout.
example: Book: To Kill a Mockingbird by Harper Lee
